title: Next Number With the Same Popcount
constraints: `nxt` = the smallest number greater than `x` with the **same number of 1 bits**. If none fits in 16 bits (or `x = 0`), `nxt = 0`.
Purely combinational. No loops, no `/` or `%`, and no `$countones`.
hints: Gosper's hack: `s = x & -x` (lowest 1), `r = x + s` (the lowest block of ones ripples into the next 0).
The ones that fell off go back at the bottom: `ones = ((x ^ r) >> 2) / s`, and `nxt = r | ones`.
Division by a power of two is a right shift by its index. Find the index of the one-hot `s` without loops by OR-ing it under the masks 0xAAAA, 0xCCCC, 0xF0F0 and 0xFF00.
Keep r 17 bits wide: a carry out of bit 15 means there is no next value.
